This was to be Graham Macky's last appearance for us before returning to his native N.Zealand the following day and on paper it looked as though we might have an outside chance of sending him on his way with some kind of team medal.
In January we lost probably the most talented Senior road and country runner to join us for a considerable while when Graham Macky returned home to New Zealand.

Leo Coy hit the airwaves in January when he appeared as the final questioner on Radio 4's Sports Review and Quiz. Graham Macky has written from New Zealand. He and Debbie were married last year and it suits him.

Congratulations to Debbie and Graham Macky on the arrival of a baby daughter - Bridie - born on Christmas Day. Graham ran a 2.16.17 marathon in Hiroshima in October '85 and lowered the club record to 2.16.11 a month later in the Beizing (Peking) marathon.
